entities.name: 2021 Western United States UAP incident
aliases: Western United States Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena
entities.description: Military personnel in 2021 reported five equidistant lights on an infrared sensor as a potential incursion into restricted military airspace in the western United States; resolved by AARO as commercial aircraft up to 300 nautical miles away.

entities.description: Oblong dots/lights that flew at a relatively constant pace; assessed to be commercial aircraft
